card.name: Linking words before clotting terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, or, and an that come right before a clot-related term like thrombosis, embolism, hematoma or thrombotic events. It appears in warnings about clotting risk.

modes.label: of before clot terms
modes.description: The word of after signs, history or rates, just before thrombosis or embolism.
modes.example: Monitor patients for signs and symptoms<< of>> venous thrombosis and pulmonary emb

modes.label: or / an before clot terms
modes.description: The word or or an inside a list or phrase that leads into a clotting or bleeding condition.

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a clotting-related condition is named in a warning.
